failed_payment.audience: memberships past_due with a grace date (we only know when a payment attempt failed)
failed_payment.description: Failed-payment recovery: the facts, the date access pauses, how to update the card. No pressure, no fake deadlines.

steps.subject: Your Strong Years payment didn't go through
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Your last membership payment didn't go through. Nothing is lost: your sessions, your numbers and your printables are all still here.

Access continues until {{grace_date}}. To keep it going, update your card on your account page: {{account_url}}

If you meant to stop, you don't need to do anything. Questions? Reply to this email and a person on our team will answer.

The Strong Years team

steps.subject: Reminder: update your card to keep Strong Years
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

A quick reminder that your membership payment still needs a working card. Access continues until {{grace_date}}.

Update it here: {{account_url}}

If you'd rather pause or pay less, the same page has a pause option and the $12 Essentials plan.

The Strong Years team

steps.subject: Last note about your Strong Years payment

This is our last note about the payment. If the card isn't updated by {{grace_date}}, your membership pauses. Your history and numbers stay saved, and you can come back anytime.

Update the card: {{account_url}}

Thank you for practicing with us.

The Strong Years team

member_onboarding.audience: paying members, days 0 to 14 from the first payment
member_onboarding.description: Member onboarding d0 to d14. Day 0 (the welcome with the sign-in link) is sent by orders/paid.

steps.subject: (welcome, sent by orders/paid)
steps.body: (welcome, sent by orders/paid)

steps.subject: Day 1: one chair, eight minutes
steps.body:
Good morning, {{first_name}}.

Chang here. Today is simple. Push a sturdy chair against the wall. Shoes on. Kitchen counter close by.

Open today's session: {{site}}/app

Pick the version that matches today, not the one you wish matched today. If you need your hands to stand up, use your hands. That's where we start, not where we stay.

Stop if anything hurts sharply or you feel dizzy.

Chang

steps.subject: Day 2: write one number down
steps.body:
Morning, {{first_name}}.

Chang again. Yesterday you stood up from a chair. Today, count how many times you can do it in 30 seconds, then write the number down in the app: {{site}}/app/progress

That number is yours. We check it again in four weeks. No prizes, just the truth.

Chang

steps.subject: Day 3: Sun Yoon's soup
steps.body:
Hello {{first_name}},

Sun Yoon. Chang does chairs, I do soup. This week's recipe has the protein grams written in, and a box that says who should skip it.

Recipes: {{site}}/app/kitchen

Make one pot on Sunday. Eat it twice. Tell Chang it was your idea.

Sun Yoon

steps.subject: Day 5: the easier version is not cheating
steps.body:
{{first_name}},

Chang here. Some mornings the easier version is the right version. Bad sleep, sore knees, long day yesterday: pick it and do it slowly. A short session done is better than a long one skipped.

Today: {{site}}/app

Chang

steps.subject: One week in
steps.body:
{{first_name}},

Seven days. Chang here. Look at your log and count the mornings you showed up: {{site}}/app/progress

Three is good. Five is very good. Seven, and I'll tell Sun Yoon you beat her.

Next week the sessions add one new move. Same chair.

Chang

steps.subject: A question from Sun Yoon
steps.body:
Hello {{first_name}},

Sun Yoon. A real question: what's for dinner on Tuesday? Most people don't know, so they eat whatever is easy. Pick one recipe from the kitchen page tonight and put the groceries on the list now.

{{site}}/app/kitchen

Sun Yoon

steps.subject: Two weeks: what to expect next
steps.body:
{{first_name}},

Chang here. Two weeks. The sessions keep coming every morning, a new recipe from Sun Yoon every Sunday, and the strength retest at week four.

If something isn't working, a slow day, a sore spot, a question, reply to this email. A person on our team reads it.

Your account and membership details are always here: {{account_url}}

Chang

books_to_membership.audience: bought the starter books, no membership
books_to_membership.description: Cell A: the books-only buyer's 3 onboarding emails with the founding offer (email 1 = SH_books_e1 from orders/paid).

steps.subject: (sent by orders/paid as SH_books_e1)
steps.body: (sent by orders/paid as SH_books_e1)

steps.subject: How day 2 of the Reset went
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Chang here. You have the 7-Day Strength Reset. Day 2 is the one people skip, so here's the honest version: it's eight minutes, one chair, and the easier version is printed right under every move.

If you want a new session every morning after the seven days, that's what the Strong Years membership is. The founding membership is $25 a month, the price stays the same for as long as you stay subscribed, and you can cancel online in two screens. 14-day money-back guarantee on the membership charge, once per person.

Every term is on the page before you pay: {{founding_url}}

No pressure. The books are yours either way.

Chang

steps.subject: Sun Yoon on what comes after the book
steps.body:
Hello {{first_name}},

Sun Yoon. The Strong Kitchen book is yours to keep. Members get a new recipe from me every Sunday, with the grams written in and the who-should-skip box.

The founding membership is $25 a month until you cancel, cancel online anytime. The page shows the price, what renews and when, before you pay: {{founding_url}}

This is the last email about it. If you'd rather just cook from the book, I approve.

Sun Yoon

activation.audience: paying members with no practice logged 3 days after joining

steps.subject: The first session is the hardest one
steps.body:
{{first_name}},

Chang here. You joined three days ago and haven't logged a session yet. Very normal. The first one is the hardest to start.

Here's the smallest version: three minutes, seated. {{site}}/app

Three minutes still counts.

Chang

activation_lapsed.audience: paying members with no practice logged for 7 days

steps.subject: The chair is still against the wall
steps.body:
{{first_name}},

Chang here. A week without a session happens to everybody. No need to make up for it. Start with today's session, the easier version: {{site}}/app

If something got in the way, a sore knee, a busy week, reply and tell us. A person reads it.

Chang

annual_offer.audience: founding monthly members after their first renewal
annual_offer.description: The founding annual ($249/yr) offered once after renewal 1, as a request handled by a person (never charged twice).

steps.subject: Switch to yearly: $249 (optional)
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

You've been a founding member for two months now. Thank you.

If you'd like to pay yearly instead, the founding annual plan is $249 a year (instead of $300 for twelve monthly payments). It's optional. To switch, request it on your account page; a person sends the yearly checkout and ends the monthly plan the day it is paid, so you are never charged for both: {{account_url}}

If monthly suits you, change nothing.

The Strong Years team

Day 1 is free on our site: {{site}}/start

Chang

steps.subject: Sun Yoon's Tuesday soup

steps.subject: What Strong Years will be

{{first_name}},

Chang here. When Strong Years opens: a new 8 to 12 minute session every morning, an easier version of everything, Sun Yoon's recipes every Sunday, and a strength number you retest each month. Every price and term goes on one page before checkout.

You'll get one email when doors open.

Chang
